p: Regent Street runs into the centre of Wrexham, close to the station and the main shops. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre and 18+ only.

Wrexham has had a lot of attention since the Hollywood takeover of Wrexham AFC, and the Racecourse Ground, one of the oldest international football grounds in the world, draws fans from all over. In town, St Giles' Church has a grand tower and is the burial place of Elihu Yale, the benefactor of Yale University. Wrexham Museum covers local history and has a gallery dedicated to Welsh football. A short drive away, the Pontcysyllte Aqueduct carries the Llangollen Canal high over the Dee valley and is part of a World Heritage Site.
